mechanism: Prednisolone may mask symptoms of ganciclovir-induced adverse effects and immunosuppression can reduce antiviral efficacy; ganciclovir increases risk of secondary infections when combined with topical corticosteroids in ocular tissue.
action: Monitor for adequate viral control and signs of secondary infection; use prednisolone cautiously only after ganciclovir therapy is established; avoid prolonged corticosteroid use without close ophthalmologic supervision.
